find_stations.description: Search about sixty thousand internet radio stations by genre, country, region, language, name and audio quality, and get back stations that are actually playing - streams that have stopped working are left out. Every station comes back with a URL you can play straight away, its logo, its homepage and a one-line description, so a message or a player can be built from the result without any further steps. No account or API key required.

parameters.description: Optional. Part of the station's name. Capitals do not matter. Leave it empty to search by genre and place alone.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Optional. The genres and moods stations are tagged with. Pick as many as you like: a station has to carry every one of them, so one genre is a wide search and two is a narrow one. The list shows the most-used genres with the number of stations behind each, and you can type any other.
parameters.name: genres

parameters.description: Optional. Leave it empty to search everywhere. Pick a country from the list, or type its name or two-letter code. A country that matches nothing is reported with the nearest names rather than quietly returning no stations.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Optional. The state, province or city a station is filed under. Choose a country first and this lists that country's regions with the number of stations in each. Contributors type these by hand, so the same place can appear more than once (Germany has both Bavaria and Bayern) - part of a name matches them all.
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: Optional. The language a station broadcasts in. Pick one from the list, or type its name or two-letter code. Stations that broadcast in several languages match on any of them.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Optional. Leave it empty for any format. Worth setting only when whatever will play the stream is fussy - MP3 is the safest choice for older players and hardware.
parameters.name: codec

options.label: AAC: smaller than MP3 at the same quality
AAC+: better again at low bitrates

parameters.description: Optional. The lowest bitrate to accept, in kbps. 128 is ordinary music quality and 64 is fine for speech. Some stations have never reported a bitrate, and setting this leaves those out.

get_station.description: Look up one station by its id and get its current details with the fields at the top level: where to play it, its logo, its homepage, its genres, its audio quality and whether it was still playing at the last daily check. Use this to refresh a station you saved earlier, or to check that a favourite is still up. It does not count a listen - Get a station's stream link is the one that does. No account or API key required.

get_stream_link.description: Get the link to play a station, and tell Radio Browser that somebody is listening. Those listens are what the directory's popularity charts are built from, so this is the action to use whenever a workflow is about to play a stream, hand it to a player or send it to somebody - it is how the station gets credit for the listen. vote_for_station.description: Cast a vote for a station. Votes are how this community-built directory ranks itself, and a station your workflows play regularly is one worth voting for. Radio Browser counts one vote every ten minutes from one place - for any station, not one each - and quietly ignores the rest, so a busy workspace will often find a vote was not counted. This step checks the station's total before and after and tells you which happened, rather than taking the service's word for it. No account or API key required.
